name: send-only-mac-messages
description: Send direct macOS Messages and transiently verify their delivery status.
long_description: A narrow local MCP server with one outbound tool. It accepts an exact phone number and message body, tries iMessage first, falls back once to SMS/RCS after an immediate or exactly correlated definitive failure, and transiently observes only those outgoing statuses. It has no conversation, Contacts, chat, attachment, or later status lookup tools.

tools.name: tool_send_message
tools.description: Sends one direct message to an exact phone number through Messages.app, then transiently checks its send status. It tries iMessage first and falls back once to SMS/RCS after an immediate or exactly correlated definitive failure. Returns a fixed status without echoing recipient or message content.
